paragraphs.text: Schubert et al. (2018) noted that some primary antibody deficiencies are diagnosed as common variable immunodeficiency (CVID). They also noted that CVID patients whose only problem is infection make up a considerable subset of CVID cohorts.

checks.claim: Some primary antibody deficiencies are diagnosed as common variable immunodeficiency (CVID).
checks.evidence_quote: Currently known genetic causes for antibody deficiencies, some of which are diagnosed as CVID, impair early B-cell development
checks.explanation: The paper says some antibody deficiencies are diagnosed as CVID. The paper uses this term interchangeably with primary antibody deficiency.

checks.claim: CVID patients whose only clinical problem is infection make up a considerable subset of CVID cohorts.
checks.evidence_quote: Even though CVID patients suffering only from infections have been reported to present a considerable subset in CVID cohorts (e.g. Resnick et al.: 32% of 473 subjects)
checks.explanation: The paper states this directly, citing Resnick et al. (32% of 473 subjects).

paragraphs.text: Schubert et al. (2018) stated that the known genetic causes of antibody deficiencies, some of which are diagnosed as CVID, affect one of three processes: early B-cell development, B-cell receptor signaling, or how B or T cells function in the germinal center reaction.

checks.claim: Some antibody deficiencies with known genetic causes are diagnosed as CVID.
checks.evidence_quote: Currently known genetic causes for antibody deficiencies, some of which are diagnosed as CVID,

checks.claim: The known genetic causes of antibody deficiencies affect one of three processes: early B-cell development, B-cell receptor signaling, or how B or T cells function in the germinal center reaction.
checks.evidence_quote: Currently known genetic causes for antibody deficiencies, some of which are diagnosed as CVID, impair early B-cell development, B cell receptor signaling or the functionality of B- or T-cells in the germinal center reaction.
checks.explanation: The paper lists the same three processes.
